description: Final results of Problem 9: all three Campus Customs tickets worked by the agent team from a freshly reset database.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Size S was out of stock, so the team paid the overdue $840.00 rush-reprint invoice #501 (human-approved) to restart the restock, and told the customer the estimated restock date (Sept 5, 2026) with in-stock alternatives.

agents.what_they_did: Read the ticket, set it in_progress, sent it to Customer Service, then had Accounting pay the linked reprint invoice once the facts showed it was the exact out-of-stock item, asked Customer Service for the final reply with the payment result, resolved the ticket with the reply in the note, and wrote the desk handoff.

Checked stock (S = 0; M 5, L 3, XL 2) and asked Inventory about restock; paused the reply until the invoice was paid, then wrote the final reply: S out of stock, reprint paid, estimated restock Sept 5, 2026, with M/L/XL offered as alternatives.

Confirmed S is out of stock, identified invoice 501 as the rush reprint of exactly CC-TEE-WHITE S (open, 3 days overdue), and estimated restock 2026-09-05 (business date + Bulldog Print Co's 5-day lead) once paid. Moved no stock.

Re-checked invoice 501 ($840.00, open, no prior payments) and the checking balance, then requested the payment; after human approval it recorded payment #1 and the invoice became paid (checking $3,400.00 -> $2,560.00).

human_approvals.how: Approved on the desk dashboard (name typed + 'I checked the payee and the amount' box) after checking it against the bill in the database; performed by Claude Code on Jason Leduc's instruction to approve as him.

tickets.reply_sent:
Hi Tauhid,

The Classic Bulldog Tee in size S is currently out of stock. The rush reprint has been paid, and Inventory estimates that size S will be restocked on September 5, 2026. If you prefer not to wait, we currently have sizes M (5 available), L (3 available), and XL (2 available); please let us know if you’d like one of those instead or would rather wait for the estimated restock.

Campus Customs

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.outcome: The rent notice was verified against lease #1 and the $2,400.00 rent to Elm City Properties was paid (human-approved); the landlord got a payment confirmation.

agents.what_they_did: Set the ticket in_progress, had Facilities verify the notice against the lease, then sent the verified figures to Accounting to pay, asked Customer Service for a confirmation to the landlord (retried once after Customer Service hit its output-token cap), resolved the ticket with the reply in the note, and wrote the desk handoff.
Verified the notice against lease #1: requester = landlord Elm City Properties, rent $2,400.00, due 2026-09-02 (2 days out), no rent payment yet, so the notice is valid. Did not pay.

Re-checked lease #1 and cash, requested the $2,400.00 rent payment; after human approval recorded payment #2 (checking $2,560.00 -> $160.00, lease next_due moved to 2026-10-02). In a second, short run it confirmed payment #2 for Customer Service.
First attempt failed (hit the 2,000-token output cap before answering). On the retry it had Accounting confirm payment #2, then wrote the confirmation to Elm City Properties.

human_approvals.how: Approved on the desk dashboard (name typed + 'I checked the payee and the amount' box) after checking it against the bill in the database; performed by Claude Code on Jason Leduc's instruction to approve as him.

tickets.reply_sent: Hello Elm City Properties, we confirm that the $2,400 rent payment for lease 1 was recorded on August 31, 2026 (payment ID 2). —Campus Customs

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Accounting approved the 15% bulk price ($49.30 each, $986.00 for 20); only 8 size M are in stock, so the club got a quote with options (mix sizes at the bulk price, 8 M at list, or wait on a possible restock). No money moved.

agents.what_they_did: Set the ticket in_progress, asked Accounting for the allowed price, asked Inventory whether 20 size M can be supplied, then had Customer Service write the quote; resolved the ticket with the reply in the note and wrote the desk handoff.

Applied the bulk policy (10+ units -> up to 15% off): $58.00 list -> $49.30/unit, $986.00 for 20, above the $22.00 unit cost. In a follow-up run it clarified that 8 units alone are list price ($464.00) and a mixed-size order of 10+ of this SKU keeps the bulk price.

Confirmed only 8 size M on hand (short 12) plus S 4, L 14, XL 6; in a follow-up run confirmed no restock is scheduled (an apparel reprint would take about 5 days if started). Pulled no stock because nothing was accepted yet.

Re-checked stock, consulted Inventory (restock timing) and Accounting (price rules), and wrote the quote: $49.30 each / $986 for 20 if they mix in other sizes, $58 each for just the 8 size M, or ask us to explore a restock.

tickets.reply_sent:
Hello Yale AI Club,

We currently have 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M available in Aisle A, plus 4 size S, 14 size L, and 6 size XL. The approved bulk price is $49.30 each ($986 for 20) for orders of at least 10 units of this hoodie, so you could make up the 20 by choosing 12 additional units from the available sizes. If you prefer to take only up to 8 size M, those are $58 each ($464 for all 8); or let us know if you'd like us to explore restocking the remaining 12 size M—no restock is scheduled yet. How would you like to proceed?

Campus Customs
